reviews.text: I wasn't sure about bringing my reactive dog to daycare but he loves it at PupsPort!

They are an amazing place. Not only does my dog go there but so does my roommate’s and they do so well to give us updates and give the best end of day notes. It’s such a good place to help your dog learn to socialize, additionally they do seasonal photo shoots as a free bonus and they perfectly capture my baby. Thank you for helping my dog and taking such great care of her.
Incredible & quality care for pets.

The staff is always so loving and caring for the dogs. We live near by so we see the staff walking other dogs. My dog runs to the staff when he sees them outside of daycare. He has also runs to the front door of Pupsport when he isn't going there. He must know it's a safe and loving environment. The owners are also very involved and conscientious about caring for the dogs. I highly recommend this daycare!
The people at Pupsport are the best.  They are so good with my Sabbie and my dog loves to go there.  Looks forward to going all the time!!!

Dina & Her Team are the best! It’s clear she puts a lot of thought into creating a safe, positive environment for the dogs in her care (and those outside of her care-- she knows every dog in the neighborhood!!)
Thank you, Chris! We love Crinkle so much! Thank you for trusting us with your fur baby! We appreciate you!
My dog loves it here, great place with great service!
This place is great and so welcoming. They are a life saver for when I need my mini poodle watched. The owner and staff and so kind and you can tell love the dogs they care for!

I am so grateful for Pupsport. Everyone who works there is kind to my dog and me. They treat my baby like she’s their own. It’s so nice to have a local daycare that I can fully trust. Worth every cent.
Pips port is great!! My active portuguese water dog loves it there. The staff are kind and loving and Dina is full of information and training tips.  What a great find!!!

Our 11 month old puppy just started going to PupsPort and it has helped us out so much! He gets the socialization with other dogs, some TLC while we are working and he comes home so tired and chill! The pictures they sent and post showed him so happy! I wish we had done this sooner! The staff are so nice and update their social media to show what they are doing through out the day. The owner is super involved as well. We moved to Pennsport in October and so many people at the dog park recommended this place and they were not lying! It's an amazing place and if you are looking for a daycare for your pup, go to PupsPort!

My Brody boy loves it here!  He always gets so excited & leads me right to their door from the car.  Great communication from the staff & they all show the doggies lots of love!  Also love seeing the picture updates on IG throughout the day of my boy having the best time! ❤️
Our dog Lucy loves coming to spend the day or a few hours with all her friends and the great attentive staff at Puppsport!

Dina, Brian, and their crew are fabulous! They are trustworthy with our puppy, excellent communicators when the need arises, and prioritize safety and fun for the dogs every day. Highly recommend you checking them out if you have a dog that needs love and socialization while you're at work. Our pal always comes back tired and happy.

Pupsport is truly fantastic! I fully trust them to take good, attentive care of my medium-sized dog. I can tell from the pictures they send, how eager she is to go every week, and how tired she is when she comes home that she has a great time! I love having them in the neighborhood and whole heartedly recommend them to any pet parent seeking daycare!
Milo’s nails were cut the right way for the first time

My dog adores Pupsport!  I originally brought my dog here because it seemed convenient that they also have grooming available, but I love it for so many more reasons now!  Dina and Brian are SO kind and truly love and get to know each dog.  They also don’t pack a ton of dogs into a room like a lot of other daycares do. Because of that my dog is much more comfortable and actually plays all day and gets exhausted, rather than getting overwhelmed like he does at other daycares.  Highly recommend Pupsport!!!
Great staff and my dog loves going weekly. Highly recommended.

The staff at Pupsport could not be any better at what they do. Each and every member of the team truly cares for animals in the most genuine way possible and it is evident from the second you drop your dog off. Our pup has the best time there and comes home completely exhausted each day she goes. Their professionalism along with the loving care they provide place them at the top of the list of all the daycares in the city.

I absolutely love Pupsport!! And more importantly, my love, Remy, gets so excited when we approach their front door. It's easy to see why: the staff is absolutely lovely and it's clear that they adore every single doggy in the joint. I'd highly recommend. Your pup is in amazing hands. They also do baths during the week!! So great.
My dog adores coming here! She even says hi to the staff and owner on our walks outside of daycare! I know she’s loved and cared for here.

This is my pups favorite place she gets so excited when I say let’s go to PupsPort. They treat Chanel like she’s their own pet too.  Love this place and Dina and Brian the owners are the kindest people! I highly recommend PupsPort if you’re looking to socialize your dog.

PupsPort is great. A life saver. I was nervous about taking care of my son's puppy and I contacted PupsPort.  We talked on the phone about the aggressiveness my dog was showing and the owner was/is so compassionate and understanding.  She heard in my voice that I was a bit afraid and her knowledge and expertise calmed him (and me) down. She taught me some tools and some training tips.  I wasn't that afraid anymore.  My dog spent all morning there and he had such a fun time.  He seemed calmer. The staff said he was great. He just needs some training. They really know their stuff and care about the animals. I would trust them with any animal.  So grateful I called them.
I think Dina loves my dog Koby more than I do. :). A1 operation and always a great experience.

I could not recommend PupsPort enough. I’m very comfortable with sending my Brock there and they love him. They take great care of him on the days I can’t be home, and he loves hanging out with his friends. So Thank you for taking such great care of by baby boy.
I love pupsport! They take such great care of my dog while I'm at work. He loves spending time there and I love their daily report cards. Highly recommend them!!

Dina and Brian are so professional and run a tight ship! They care for all the dogs like they’re their own and safety and cleanliness are priority… but also love and attention! Our girl has been cared for by them since she was a puppy and we trust them without hesitation. You and your pupper will be so happy you chose PupsPort!

Pupsport in South Philly is awesome! The staff are super chill, kind, and professional—they really get my dog, quirks and all (even the air humping). She shows up with full bulldog attitude, judging everyone and unimpressed by the chaos. But by the time I pick her up, she’s a tired, happy pup. The place is clean, well-organized, and I never have to worry when she’s there. They even do fun little photo shoots to capture each dog’s personality. I’ve already recommended them to a few friends!
This is our puppy’s favorite place in the world
Very caring, loving daycare. They make it interesting for the dogs and fun always!!
We love PupsPort! The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable, and booking is really easy online. Our dog Bruce always comes home happy and tired. Highly recommend!
Love Pupsport!! My dog Bailey really enjoys coming here and she gets such good care. The mid day works are amazing for full days of daycare so each dog gets a little one on one time

Per Remy a Maltese Shih Tzu says: BEST. PLACE. EVER. 🐾

Hi hooman friends and furry pals!
I’m Remy, a 16-lb ball of fluffy joy and tail-wagging enthusiasm — part Maltese, part Shih Tzu, all heart. And let me tell you… PupsPort Dog Daycare is my happy place! 🐶💕

From the moment my paws hit the parking lot, I’m bouncing like a squeaky toy on espresso. The second those doors open? I’m greeted like a celebrity by the amazing PupsPort staff...The staff? Un-fur-gettable. They don’t just watch me — they know me. They scratch my favorite spot behind my ear, call me by name (with the right amount of drama, thank you very much), and they even know when I’m in the mood for zoomies vs. snuggles. That’s real talent. 🎓🐾....Every time I leave, I’m happily exhausted and my human parents are HAPPY!!!

Tail wags and happy howls,
🐾 Remy the Maltese Shih Tzu

Pupsport is amazing! The owners and staff are so attentive and nice, and they treat our little Dachsund Dino like one of their own! The facility is always clean. He truly loves going to “school” at Pupsport, and he sprints there in the morning to play with his friends.
Puppsport takes great care of the dogs and posts lots of updates and keeps everyone happy and healthy.

We LOVE PupsPort! We cannot recommend it enough! It quickly became our (very sweet but very fearful) pup’s all-time favorite place.

Dina and the team working here are all wonderful - their love for the dogs (and the dogs’ love for the team!) is so clear.

We love hearing their updates about how our puppy’s day went, and feel so grateful to be able to trust our puppy is in great hands here!

PubsPort in Pennsport is fantastic! Cain, my puppy, always gets so excited when we visit. It's clear he’s super well taken care of, and the attention he receives is phenomenal. From booking to the care Cain gets, everything is top-notch. The staff here are amazing—friendly, attentive, and truly dedicated. Highly recommend this place if you want excellent service and a great experience! Plus, they offer affordable rates and custom reports at the end of the day, which is a nice touch.

Best dog day care! Dina and her staff are so attentive and caring.
The facility is always clean and my pup is always excited to go to daycare and see all his friends.
Dina and her staff are also super accommodating with special requests or last minute bookings.
Absolutely just the best place!! Literally my dog lives for this place.
Best decision to take him to daycare at Pupsport PHL!

My puppy has been going there for over 4 months and I really trust them with my puppy who is my daughter! They’re compassionate, patient, and thorough!

They always get back to me of any concerns with my pup, even told me about a lump on her face that I didn’t notice!

The space is a tad smaller, but my pup tires out at the end of the day and she LOVES it there. The staff there is excellent, super friendly and it’s very clean.  I highly recommend them!!
We love PupsPort! Our pup has been coming here for the past few years and he loves it. The facility is clean, and the owners are wonderful! Great having it Pennsport.

I could not say enough about PupsPort. Really, I say here and wrote it several sentences and all fell flat.  Dina and Brian and the crew are just kind people. They watch and play with and take care of and clean up after a posse of old dogs, young dogs, active dogs, dogs that just want to nap... seriously, it's like a Benneton ad... with such caring that I couldn't imagine bringing my Clara anywhere else.  Considering the level of service I'd say it's bargain, too. I've refer them to several other dog people and they all rave about the joint. Of course, my dog Clara is their FAVORITE, but I think they say that to everybody.

PupsPort is a neighborhood gem! The staff is so friendly and caring. We know our pup is in good hands and has the best time at daycare. We follow along on Instagram to see all the fun. They write a thoughtful report after each visit and you can tell they understand your dog's personality and needs. ❤️
Very nice people and you get a wrote up of how your dog did after every session.

I can not recommend PupsPort enough. They love my Poppy girl just as much as I do and It shows! I always know she is in great hands when I drop her off. My girl has the biggest puppy smile on her face whenever anyone even says the word “daycare”! I am so happy I made the decision to start bringing my dog to PupsPort. Great staff, great owners, great place.

What a great place to bring your dog! The owners and staff are amazing. The place is extremely clean and the owner is there every day which is amazing and something you don't see in a lot of businesses. Staff is trained and very attentive to all the dogs they have with different behaviors and plays styles. Owners & staff are always quick to answer any questions or concerns! I had the pleasure of working with Dina the owner for a little bit while she was getting ready to open her daycare. She is very passionate about pet care and treats all of the dogs as if they were her own! Your dog is definitely in safe hands here and will be spoiled!

We have been sending our 1 year old puppy to Pupsport a few times a week for the last several months and I cannot rave about them more. My doggy is my LIFE and I wanted to find a place where she felt safe and I felt safe taking her. We tried a few other day care spots, and Pupsport was the perfect fit. Now my energetic Luna girl comes home tired and happy after a perfect day at her daycare. We even tried the new groomer and they did an amazing job.Thank you Pupsport for loving our Luna like we do! <3
Great place

I've been taking my pup to Pups Port since they opened, and I cannot say enough good things. They are kind, helpful, caring, and they run a safe and reliable business. They recently started working with a new groomer, and WOW. My dog has always been terrified of being groomed. He normally gets very stressed and is difficult to work with. But This groomer has the magic touch. My dog didn't get stressed out while he was being groomed (the owner Dina was watching on a little camera they have for safety and she noted how relaxed he was), and he has the best groom I have ever seen! The attention to detail was awesome. I highly recommend taking your dog to Pups Port!

My dog has the absolute time of his life at Pupsport, and I recommend them to anyone in South Philly looking for dog daycare. The staff are kind, friendly, accommodating, and Gavin always leaves happy (and zonked) at the end of the day.

Our pup LOVES PupsPort! She gets excited every time we walk up to the door to go play with friends. Even better for us, she comes home exhausted! Everyone there is so kind and friendly, the communication is great, and the facility is …

Dina and Brian (and their team) take such good care of our pup! The love and socialization they provide him is so lovely, and every day ends with a summary of how he did that day. He loves his friends, human and canine, and we appreciate them ❤️

I’ve been bringing my dog Teddy to Pupsport regularly for the past year, and it’s been a fantastic experience. Teddy absolutely loves it there—he excitedly runs to the door! Despite being shy around most people, he adores the staff, which …
My dog Waldo is always happy to go here for daycare & has the best time 🥰 I like following the Instagram story to see what he gets up to when he visits …

This is the first time I’ve had a puppy and it’s the best decision I have ever made. I needed someone to watch her a few days a week because of work so I did research and came across PupsPort Dog Daycare. It was the best decision I’ve ever …

So happy we found PupsPort! Everyone is so nice and welcoming, they offer a free trial day to make sure your pup is comfortable and safe before committing to a half or full day! Papa is obsessed with going, he gets super excited to hang out …
